product.description: Replacement power adapter (Part No. GX20P92529, GX20P92530, 4X20M26272) for Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon 5th Gen, ThinkPad X1 Yoga 2nd Gen, ThinkPad X1 Tablet Gen 2, ThinkPad 13 2nd Gen, ThinkPad T470, T470s, T570, T570s, ThinkPad X270, and other USB-C enabled ThinkPad, Yoga and IdeaPad Slim/Flex models. USB Type-C connector delivering up to 65W (5V/2A, 9V/2A, 15V/3A, 20V/3.25A). Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Not compatible with older Lenovo laptops using rectangular or round barrel connectors. Tested before dispatch, drop-in replacement for the original charger.

faqs.question: How do I know this charger fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: Each listing shows the wattage and connector type. If you're unsure, send us a photo of your original charger or your laptop model on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: Is a higher-wattage charger safe to use?
faqs.answer: Yes — a charger rated higher than your laptop's original wattage is safe; your laptop only draws what it needs. A lower-wattage charger should be avoided.
